description: Return complete structured metadata for one resource: descriptions (EN/AZ), capabilities, tools, transports, auth, packages, compatibility, pricing, security profile, quality signals (stars, last commit), installation and links. Accepts a slug, numeric id, exact name, ABCommunity page URL or GitHub 'owner/repo'. If nothing matches, the error lists the closest slugs.

language.description: Language of descriptions in the text summary: 'en' (default) or 'az' (Azerbaijani). The JSON always carries both.

slug.description: Slug, exact name, ABCommunity URL or GitHub owner/repo, e.g. 'github-github-mcp-server' or 'github/github-mcp-server'

name: get_resource
title: Get full resource metadata
